article.excerpt: OKITE is a Japanese alarm clock app. It’s designed to help users wake up, but with a twist: it sends embarrassing messages to the user’s Twitter account every time they hit snooze. And what does it send ?: “From today on I’m going to head to work via unicycle.” “I want to buy a fast red Ferrari and a horse!” “Just as I thought, I want to become a stewardess.
